"""Read-only source-pinned native baseline replay; scratch output only."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

product = Path('/workspace/e02-F-base-control/policy-engine')
out_dir = Path('/workspace/e02-F-receipts')
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update(UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT='/workspace/polisyos/policy-engine/.venv',
           UV_NO_SYNC='1', PYTHONPATH='src:.', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
argv = ['uv', 'run', 'polisyos-tools', 'validation', 'check-docs-freshness-baseline']
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=product, text=True).strip()
status = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=product, text=True)
assert head == 'c40d4acae1ce58b597267255026d9356565828fd' and not status
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
begin = time.perf_counter()
result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=product, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
wall = time.perf_counter() - begin
body = (f'source_sha={head}\nsource_clean=true\ncwd={product}\n'
        f'argv={json.dumps(argv)}\nstarted_utc={started}\n'
        f'python=3.14.2; native CI used 3.14.7\n'
        f'wall_seconds={wall:.6f}\nexit_code={result.returncode}\n'
        f'--- stdout (complete) ---\n{result.stdout}'
        f'--- stderr (complete) ---\n{result.stderr}')
target = out_dir / 'F-docs-base-freshness-native-replay.txt'
target.write_text(body)
record = dict(source_sha=head, source_clean=True, argv=argv, cwd=str(product),
              started_utc=started, wall_seconds=wall, exit_code=result.returncode,
              stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr, output_path=str(target),
              output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              attribution='Base same failure replay only; complete denominator proof not yet established.')
(out_dir/'F-docs-base-freshness-native-replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in record.items() if key not in ('stdout', 'stderr')}, indent=2))
print(result.stdout)
